question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Oppose
solution:
The correct answer is: **Encourage**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• **Oppose**: Disagree with and attempt to prevent, especially by argument. (विरोध करना)
 
• Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section.
 
 
• **Embody**: To represent a quality or an idea exactly. (मूर्त रूप देना; साकार करना)
 
• **Resist**: To fight against or oppose something or someone. (किसी चीज या किसी का विरोध करना; रोक लगाना)
 
• **Encourage**: Give support, confidence, or hope to someone. (हिम्मत बढाना; किसी को समर्थन, विश्वास या आशा देना)
 
• **Elective**: Open to choice; optional; not required. (वैकल्पिक; आवश्यक नहीं)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Oppose**' is '**Encourage**'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
